adjudication.rationale: The diff shows new sequential per-item DB lookups inside loops. In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, it iterates `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` and, when the credential isn’t found in `this.calendarCredentials`, performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique(...)` inside the loop before calling `createEvent(...)`. Similarly, in `updateBooking`, it iterates over `calendarReference` and does the same `await prisma.credential.findUnique(...)` fallback per reference when `credential` is missing. Because these are `for...of` loops with an `await` in the body, the lookups are serialized, making latency scale roughly linearly with number of destination calendars/references (e.g., team size for COLLECTIVE). This is a concrete performance/architecture concern introduced by the change rather than a correctness defect.
